That'd be fun. Every once in a while some really great music shows up in cartoons. It's a nice shock. The next one, "Jukebox Jenny," 1942. 61 minutes, directed by Harold Young. Formula romance with music about a record salesman who builds jukebox star out of a young singer. Features Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra, with Cliff Leeman, drums, Wingy Manone and His Orchestra, the Milt Herb Trio and the Kingsmen, plus the song, "Fifty Million Nickels," by Charlie Barnet.
